Title: Add — backend save-validation rejects End-before-Start and a negative reward, and does not reject their valid boundary neighbors (End=Start, reward=0)
Section: Admin > Loyalty Missions > Details > Save validation
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:ADMIN_DEFAULT]
1. No existing mission named AGENT-TEST-MSNA-023-* on @td(STORE_PRIMARY.id) (this case creates and abandons a Draft mission — Draft missions ARE editable/deletable per MSNA-012's established Published-only immutability, so no seed data is required).
2. Dev comment on VCST-5319 (upd. 2026-08-20) marks "backend save-validation" complete — this case is the first coverage of it; MSNA-007 (no goal) and MSNA-011 (reward=0, already confirmed accepted) cover adjacent ground and are not re-tested here.
Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/loyalty-missions
[WAIT] grid loaded
[ACT] click 'Add' (new mission)
[WAIT] details blade opens (Draft)
[ACT] type {{mission_name}} into Name
[ACT] select goal type OrderCountGoal, set target = 1
--- End-before-Start (invalid) ---
[ACT] set Start date = today
[ACT] set End date = today minus 1 day
[ACT] click Save
[WAIT] server round-trip completes (toast or inline error, or Save remains disabled)
--- correct to End=Start (valid boundary) ---
[ACT] set End date = today (same as Start)
[ACT] click Save
[WAIT] save completes
--- negative reward (invalid) ---
[ACT] set reward amount = -1
[ACT] click Save
[WAIT] server round-trip completes (toast or inline error, or Save remains disabled)
--- correct to reward = 0 (valid boundary, MSNA-011 precedent) ---
[ACT] set reward amount = 0
[ACT] click Save
[WAIT] save completes, grid/blade reflects the saved mission
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] MSN-027 (075d, this same VCST-5319 batch) exercises the corresponding GraphQL-side accrual window once a mission is Published — this case only covers the Admin-authoring gate.
Failure_Signals: Save appears to succeed (blade re-titles, Save/Reset disable) with End < Start still set (no date-order validation exists at all — the dev-comment "backend save-validation" item is incomplete); same false-success signal with reward = -1 (same, for the reward field); the non-save signal persists even after BOTH corrections (over-strict validation — a REAL valid mission, per MSNA-011's own accepted reward=0 boundary, is being rejected); two rows appear for {{mission_name}} (a client-side-only rejection let a retry double-submit)
References: VCST-5319; C5 (dev comment item 5) | Archetype:BOUNDARY | Technique:EP
